decisions_not_to_reverse: Raw source evidence is authority; derived summaries/goldens do not replace it.
PIR owns pedagogy semantics; benchmarker independently scores; Study OS adopts pinned tested PIR.
PAM is assurance, not pedagogy or runtime logic.
Semantic equivalence never permits deletion of an evidenced intermediate pedagogical state.
Source accounting and semantic understanding are different claims.
Historical learner meta-turns are calibration evidence, not automatically literal future runtime gates.
Deterministic controller owns progression; renderer/model is bounded.
Renderer-visible contracts never contain hidden grading answers.
Learner-visible output is a falsification surface; hidden preserve flags are insufficient.

For the evidenced September-4 trajectory, language/register is an independent learner-facing control axis from semantic meaning and visual representation; control it with versioned source-backed profiles and explicit restoration, without universalizing the specific lexicon.
Do not freeze a universal pedagogy ontology from one learner/session.
